visualCharacteristics.summary: Dynamic Media video player with caption/audio track support.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embeds a Dynamic Media video player (viewer iframe or video file), lazy loaded, with optional click-to-play poster.

contentPattern.summary: Dynamic Media video player is an interactive component; the player is rendered client-side so the video URL must be taken from the source block config.
contentPattern.structure: one row; a cell with the Dynamic Media video URL (viewer page, .../play player, or .mp4), optional poster image and optional caption paragraph

cells: video URL (Dynamic Media .../play or asset URL), optional poster image

occurrences.reason: Dynamic Media video player is an interactive component; the player is rendered client-side so the video URL must be taken from the source block config.

usage: Single row with the Dynamic Media video URL: a viewer page (scene7 s7viewers/*.html), a Dynamic Media with Open API player (.../play), or a direct video file (.mp4). Optional poster image makes it click-to-play.
reuseGuidance: Use for any Dynamic Media video or viewer that renders client-side. Generic YouTube/Vimeo embeds belong in a video/embed block.
